03 / HOW I WORKA CLEAR PROCESS. ROOM TO EXPLORE.

From understanding
to refinement.

✳
01 / 06
01

Discover

Understand the context.

I learn about the product, its audience, business goals, and existing challenges before defining what needs attention.

Listen → Review → Define
02

Structure

Make the experience make sense.

I organise information and map key journeys so the product feels clear, connected, and easy to navigate.

Organise → Map → Prioritise
03

Explore

Explore possible directions.

I use references, sketches, and early wireframes to compare ideas and find a direction that fits the problem.

Research → Sketch → Explore
04

Design

Bring the direction to life.

I develop the interface, visual language, and reusable components while keeping usability and consistency in focus.

Layout → Design → Systemise
05

Refine

Review the details.

I review screens and interactions, check design consistency, and refine the experience based on feedback and project needs.

Review → Check → Refine
06

Hand Over

Prepare for implementation.

I organise design files and specifications, communicate interaction details, and review the implementation to help keep it aligned with the design.

Document → Handover → Review

HI, I’M RAHA.

Thoughtful by design.
Creative in every detail.

I’m a UI/UX Designer with a background in visual design. My work sits at the intersection of usability, structure, and visual communication. I enjoy turning complex information into clear experiences and paying attention to the small details that make a product feel considered.

I value collaboration, open communication, and taking responsibility for the work. I enjoy being part of a team, balancing different tasks, and staying attentive to both the process and the final result.
